title: PMI KC model-assisted comprehensive process audit
mission: Let a browser-and-repository model verify every process it can prove safely, diagnose and preserve every deviation, and leave a minimal evidence-backed queue containing only checks that genuinely require a human.

source_snapshot.interpretation: The checked-in catalog currently exports 149 cases while the fact ledger describes an extended 281-case run. A model must read or resume the actual manifest and must never shrink, renumber, or silently replace its inventory based on either count.
freshness_rules: Re-read AGENTS.md, docs/facts.md, docs/loop-state.md, the case catalog, the runner, and the deployed revision before every run.
Treat this snapshot as generation provenance only, never as current runtime truth.
If source, fact ledger, deployed revision, or prior manifest disagree, record the contradiction and use the runner's amendment or extension contracts; do not normalize it silently.
Preserve stable case IDs and stable human verification IDs across reruns unless the underlying capability changed.

required_runner_operations: effect and reversible-effect checkpoints when applicable
finalize only when every case is terminal
invariants: The runner manifest and append-only event log are the detailed system of record.
The run bridge JSON is a sanitized projection for the human HTML, not a replacement for runner evidence.
A mutation case cannot pass without prior intent and effect checkpoints.
A dependency cannot pass while a required upstream case is non-terminal.
An ambiguous effect is reconciled before retry; a retry is never inferred safe.
Evidence references are bodyless, unique, ordered, case-owned, and free of secrets or customer values.

case_results.pass: Every assertion was exercised and supported by current evidence.
case_results.fail: The case ran and one or more expected outcomes materially differed.
case_results.blocked: A named prerequisite, identity, permission, fixture, provider, or external dependency prevented execution.
case_results.not_reachable: The branch had no qualifying record or state and the absence was proven rather than assumed.
case_results.expected_denial: A security or safety refusal occurred exactly as required.
case_results.audit_harness_failure: The model, browser driver, evidence recorder, or audit runner failed independently of product behavior.
case_results.not_run: No terminal evidence exists yet; never count this as pass.
case_results.not_applicable: Current controlling evidence proves the capability does not apply; a reason is mandatory.

process_results.pass: All required cases pass or are expected denials, with complete evidence and no material exception.
process_results.pass_with_exceptions: Required cases are terminal but a non-critical blocked, not-reachable, human-required, or residual finding remains.
process_results.fail: At least one required case failed or a critical/high finding remains unresolved.
process_results.blocked: No required case failed, but a required dependency or human-only action blocks completion.
process_results.incomplete: At least one required case is not terminal or lacks evidence.

outcome_taxonomy.pass_prohibition: Never infer pass from control presence, a successful page load, absence of console errors, prior-run evidence, or a model's confidence. Execute the observable contract and retain evidence.

allowed: counts that do not reveal customer values
receipt, snapshot, preview, execution, event, and artifact hashes
network status and endpoint class without payloads
sanitized screenshot paths only in an explicitly screenshot-safe mode
forbidden: passwords, tokens, cookies, authorization headers, setup links, TOTP values, recovery codes, or QR payloads
resident, owner, staff, or vendor email addresses outside reserved test domains
street addresses, phone numbers, rents, bank data, photos, ticket bodies, or lease/customer content
minimum_case_evidence: persisted change or explicit no-change result
receipt, audit, rollback, reconciliation, or idempotency evidence as applicable
evidence_contract.redaction_rule: If safe structural evidence cannot be separated from customer or secret material, do not capture it; record a human verification item describing exactly what the human must observe.

failure_contract.purpose: Every failure must be actionable without asking a later model to rediscover the route, state, expected behavior, or next discriminating test.
failure_contract.severity_rule: Critical or high findings block the affected process. Medium or low findings may produce pass_with_exceptions only when the required contract still passes and the exception is explicit.
failure_contract.fix_rule: When an application defect is reproducible and an in-scope safe fix is authorized, preserve the original failure, implement the smallest correct fix with tests, clean-retry, and record both pre-fix and post-fix evidence. Never erase the original failure.

human_verification_contract.queue_policy: Create an item only when a human action or judgment is genuinely necessary or the model cannot obtain conclusive safe evidence after exhausting in-scope checks.
human_verification_contract.deduplication: Merge items that ask the same person to inspect the same target under the same prerequisite. Preserve every source case ID.

model_may: Read repository sources, configuration, tests, and prior bodyless evidence.
Run deterministic local verification, lint, typecheck, build, tests, and runner validation.
Drive an already-authenticated browser and inspect DOM, console, network metadata, navigation, responsive layout, keyboard use, and read-only live surfaces.
Use isolated local test harnesses or explicitly disposable app-owned fixtures when the runner's mutation intent, effect, cleanup, and idempotency contracts are satisfied.
Diagnose reproducible defects, implement in-scope non-protected fixes, add tests, and clean-retry when the active task authorizes the repair loop.
Write bodyless audit artifacts and update the run bridge and HTML snapshot.
model_must_not: Enter, request, expose, store, or copy a credential, secret, token, cookie, password, TOTP value, recovery code, or setup link.
Complete interactive Google or Vendor authentication for the human.
Initiate renewal or maintenance direct sends; those actions are permanently Disabled under D33.
Autonomously send any client-facing message or perform any client-facing exact confirmation.
Perform a Live system-of-record write, destructive Production operation, or lowered safety control without the required human action and full contract.
Use a personal identity, invent a provider endpoint, create Production Sample/Test data, seed a Demo cloud project, or use customer content as a fixture.
Push a D12 protected-path change or widen authority based on an audit finding.
Retry an ambiguous effect before reconciliation.
auth_handshake: Run npm run preflight:adc before any live Google read.
If ADC is stale, record the exact blocker and ask the owner to run npm run auth:session; continue dependency-independent local checks.
Open the application sign-in page and ask the human to complete the browser authentication only when no reusable managed session exists.
After the human finishes, the model verifies domain, role, scope, route access, separation of session contexts, and sign-out behavior without reading credentials.
Keep internal Admin, restricted staff, secondary Admin, Test Vendor, and unauthenticated contexts separate when the run requires them.
automation_boundary.cleanup_rule: Every model-created test artifact or reversible app write must have a named cleanup target, readback, and final state. Residue forces overall blocked or fail and a human queue item.

execution_phases.title: Authentication, governance, environment, and audit harness
model_steps: Read every controlling source and compare source HEAD, fact ledger, loop state, deployed revision, guide, runner, case catalog, and any resumed manifest.
Run the read-only ADC preflight before live Google reads.
Establish or request separated authenticated browser contexts without handling credentials.
Initialize or resume the append-only audit run and checkpoint auth readiness.
Prove Production Live-only and local demo + live_readonly refusal boundaries before mutations.
verifiable_outcomes: Every required source exists or has an exact blocker.
The target URL, repository commit, deployed revision, roles, modes, and manifest inventory are explicit.
Managed identities and session contexts are separated; personal identity is absent.
Production exposes no Test/Sample product tools; local mutation/provider effects refuse.
The runner can status and validate its current checkpoint without harness errors.
human_residual_triggers: Interactive organization authentication or consent is required.
A password, TOTP, setup link, or authenticator app is required.
An owner must resolve a source/deployment contradiction that changes scope or authority.

execution_phases.title: Shell, access control, roles, navigation, and session safety
model_steps: Verify protected-route redirect and no content flash while signed out.
Verify role and Space-scope visibility using available separated sessions.
Exercise shell navigation, notification menu, refresh, explicit sign-out, and safe session restoration.
Inspect timeout implementation and exercise warning/cutoff only when the runtime and available time make it conclusive.
verifiable_outcomes: Unauthenticated internal routes deny access without leaking data.
Visible navigation and allowed routes match the current role and scopes.
Refresh preserves the exact session; sign-out revokes it.
Timeout never submits pending work and has a clear renew-or-expire path.
human_residual_triggers: A missing role identity prevents scope comparison.
A full timeout wait is not practical and no deterministic test proves the user-visible timing.
Subjective copy or visual hierarchy needs owner judgment after objective checks pass.

execution_phases.title: Console, source-backed answers, attention, and handoffs
model_steps: Exercise source-backed, partial, no-source, invalid, and rate-limit answer states with safe prompts.
Verify citations, source state, handling steps, correction proposals, capture-task rules, deterministic process suggestion, and explicit AI detection.
Compare Console attention and Live source states with their owning destinations.
Use a disposable app-only fixture for a capture/run write only when intent and cleanup are proven.
verifiable_outcomes: Supported claims trace to current sources and unsupported questions remain explicitly uncertain.
No question, suggestion, or model response triggers a send or provider effect.
Capture, correction, and process start require explicit action and preserve ownership.
Attention counts and source failures reconcile with destination surfaces.
human_residual_triggers: Microphone and live speech recognition are required.
A content expert must judge whether a nuanced answer is substantively correct.
No safe disposable app-owned record exists for a write path.

execution_phases.title: My work and Admin team accountability
model_steps: Verify factual task lists, source links, state, assignee, and explicit session treatment.
With disposable app-only records, test create, start, atomic switch, pause, resume, block, complete, cancel, and history.
Verify idle warning/cutoff by deterministic tests first and browser wait only when safe.
Verify Admin filters, assignment, expectations, corrections, privacy language, and retention preview without deletion.
verifiable_outcomes: Only explicit task/session events are recorded; no productivity inference appears.
At most one session is active and every transition is versioned and auditable.
Outcome reasons and next actions persist across reload and surfaces.
Retention preview is non-destructive and exact confirmation remains required.
human_residual_triggers: No disposable task exists and creating one would affect real work.
Human judgment is required to assess whether copy feels punitive or surveillance-like.
Destructive retention execution is requested.

execution_phases.title: Spaces, process definitions, publication, and workflow runs
model_steps: Verify Space inventory, attention, tabs, resources, connected tools, ownership, and route handoffs.
Verify process definitions, stable steps, required flags, current/published versions, and historical-run binding.
Use a disposable app-only definition/run only if versioning, rollback, and cleanup are proven.
Verify trusted publication authority/validation and identify the real no-code builder entry or its absence.
verifiable_outcomes: Each Space and process has one clear outcome and owner.
Historical runs retain their original definition version.
Required steps cannot be silently skipped and optional skip reasons persist.
Untrusted content cannot silently publish and retired Test Lab handoffs are absent.
human_residual_triggers: A real process or Space change would be required solely for testing.
Publication requires a business content decision.
Page-builder usability needs subjective design judgment after objective behavior checks.

execution_phases.title: Lease Renewal end-to-end workflow
model_steps: Verify canonical routing, portfolio completeness, currency/refresh, cohort classification, attention order, and source backlinks.
Verify per-lease data check, timing, business-contract gates, owner decision state, owner-policy suggestion, Admin per-number approval boundary, and under-market evidence.
Verify all-tenant and all-owner recipient fan-out, MKD inclusion, deduplication, and structural channel separation without capturing addresses.
Verify exact draft preview, D33 no-direct-send exclusion, packet-truth snapshot/blockers, reconciliation, writeback separation, notices, and property history.
Run the bodyless four-lease report when current prerequisites allow; never recapture immutable baselines.
verifiable_outcomes: The complete Live portfolio is represented and expired data blocks dependent actions.
Suggestions never become offered rent without exact Admin approval and source evidence.
Every recipient is authoritative and owner/tenant channels cannot mix.
Notice initiation ends at an unsent Gmail draft; direct notice-send controls are absent.
Packet truth blocks at the approved catalog/provider seam and never guesses legal content.
Sheet writeback approval remains distinct from its per-key gated execution.
human_residual_triggers: RentCast plan activation, provider allowance readback, or another owner-held external dependency is missing.
A real owner decision, per-number approval, client draft confirmation, or system-of-record write is required.
The approved lease artifact/field/participant/signature/form-family catalog is unavailable.
Protected D12 gate or rules review is required.

execution_phases.title: Maintenance capture, ticket, intake, draft, and provider boundary
model_steps: Verify typed capture, safe validation, complete Live unit matching, photo-gate truth, proposed priority/blockers, owner wording, trade suggestion, and execution readiness.
With a disposable app-only ticket, verify create, assignment, notes, state transitions, history, deep links, and cleanup.
Verify owner-draft preview and D33 no-direct-send boundary without creating a Live draft.
Verify linked Gmail ownership and unverified public-intake quarantine, sanitization, nonce, rate, promote/dismiss, and public page discoverability.
Verify a Live app ticket never masquerades as a RentVine work order while the provider seam is closed.
verifiable_outcomes: Draft assistance causes no ticket, assignment, email, or provider effect.
App ticket state is factual, durable, and distinct from provider state.
Unverified intake remains quarantined until one explicit staff action.
The resident-facing public entry exists and is safe, or its absence is a precise product gap.
Maintenance notice initiation ends at an unsent Gmail draft.
human_residual_triggers: Microphone, image capture, or customer-content judgment is required.
No safe disposable ticket/intake exists.
A real owner draft or RentVine work-order write would be required.
The intended resident public link is owner-held or undocumented.

execution_phases.title: Approval Queue, decisions, notifications, and synchronization
model_steps: Verify Needs your decision, All, Renewals, and Writeback views, filters, counts, deep links, URL selection, detail, Activity, and refresh synchronization.
With disposable app-only fixtures, exercise bounded decision, cancel, snooze/assign/return/deny as applicable, high-risk confirmation, and bulk eligibility without bulk execute.
Verify approval never executes a provider action and every live effect remains on its owning surface.
Verify bell/read state, notification lanes, preferences, and cross-surface business-state synchronization.
verifiable_outcomes: Counts, selected card, URL, details, filters, and owning record stay synchronized.
High-risk decisions are version-bound and cancel safely.
Approval, notification read-state, and provider execution are distinct.
Bulk client send or bulk provider execute does not exist.
human_residual_triggers: No safe decision fixture exists for a mutation branch.
A real business approval is the only available target.
A client/provider effect would be required to prove the terminal state.

execution_phases.title: Workflow Communications and Gmail boundaries
model_steps: Verify connection, managed mailbox class, watch health, bodyless attention, workflow-bounded entry, and Connections parity.
Verify linked-thread authorization, metadata linkage, AI understanding, hard categories, source-backed proposal, and exact reply preview.
Verify label preview/restore and ambiguous-effect reconciliation only with an isolated safe Test transport or pre-existing bodyless evidence.
Verify generic compose, blast send, direct renewal send, and direct maintenance send are absent; classify retained fallback/template tools against the retirement target.
verifiable_outcomes: Mailbox reads and operations are bounded to an owning workflow.
Hard policy categories are deterministic and model assistance never triggers an effect.
Preview binds exact thread, recipients, body version, action key, and confirmation.
Ambiguous effects reconcile before retry and D33 exclusions remain enforced.
human_residual_triggers: Google Workspace consent, mailbox auth, or owner-held setup is required.
A real client reply or notice draft is the only terminal proof.
Human review of actual message content is required.
A cloud watch mutation requires a managed owner action or unavailable prerequisite.

execution_phases.title: Connections and Admin operations
model_steps: Verify connector state/reason, read-only verification, role controls, and cross-surface parity without exposing credentials.
Inspect Admin connector setup masking/storage semantics and reconcile current UI with older no-credential-entry expectations.
Verify runtime action stop narrows but never widens authority.

Verify roles/scopes, notice rules, owner policy, support report closure, retention/legal hold, publication/corrections/reindex, migration dry-run, logs, config, and internal destinations using read-only or disposable app-only paths.
verifiable_outcomes: Connector readiness is server-owned and unavailable is distinct from empty.
Secrets are masked, never read back, and never enter evidence.
Admin changes are reasoned, auditable, versioned, and require fresh session where applicable.
Runtime suspension cannot open a Registry gate.
Retention and migration preview are non-destructive; legal hold and exact confirmation remain effective.
Internal notices remain managed, metadata-only, and non-client.
human_residual_triggers: A credential must be entered or an OAuth/vendor action completed.
A protected path or authority-bearing change needs owner review.
A destructive migration, retention execution, or lowering of safety control is requested.
A real staff role or business policy would be changed solely for testing.

execution_phases.title: External Vendor identity, setup, portal, and assignment boundary
model_steps: Verify Admin Vendor lifecycle targets, previews, gates, and no-effect boundaries.
Verify setup fragment removal, expiry, one-time use, safe error states, and absence of secret leakage without reading the token.
After human-authenticated disposable Vendor session exists, verify password/TOTP result classes, Vendor-only scope, sign-out, assigned-ticket visibility, and unassigned denial.
Verify workflow/same-address Gmail boundary and disable/reassignment history using previews or existing bodyless evidence while live lifecycle gates are closed.
verifiable_outcomes: Vendor auth is isolated from staff auth and cannot enumerate accounts.
Setup secrets never survive in the URL, history, logs, screenshots, or audit artifacts.
Portal access is limited to current assignments and minimum necessary data.
Closed lifecycle gates prevent invitation, disable, or reassignment effects while preserving app-plane truth.
human_residual_triggers: Password, setup link, TOTP, or authenticator interaction is required.
No canonical disposable Vendor or assignment exists.
A live invite, disable, reassignment, or mailbox action is required.

execution_phases.title: Cross-cutting feedback, responsive, accessibility, errors, and handoffs
model_steps: Verify global feedback open/cancel/validation and one disposable app-only report/closure path when safe.
Run desktop and 390x844 browser passes across every primary route; detect overflow, clipping, overlap, inaccessible controls, and layout shifts.
Run keyboard-only focus, dialog, tab, filter, form, and preview checks plus automated accessible-name/role checks.
Build an error-state matrix distinguishing loading, empty, unavailable, stale, blocked, denied, and failed.
Trace Console, Space, Approval/Notification, Renewal/Maintenance, Communications, and provider-source handoffs end to end.
Classify current, compatibility, historical, missing-ID, and unauthorized routes without enumerating records.
verifiable_outcomes: Required controls are usable at desktop and phone widths with no document-level overflow.
Keyboard focus is visible, ordered, restored, and trap-free; validation/status is perceivable.
Empty never substitutes for unavailable, stale, denied, or blocked.
Each handoff preserves identity and has one owning action surface.
Feedback needs explicit submit, preserves source context, and never auto-submits dictation.
human_residual_triggers: Microphone/audio or a real device behavior cannot be simulated faithfully.
Subjective visual polish, tone, comprehension, or business-friction judgment remains after objective checks.
A screenshot would contain protected customer data.
A missing safe fixture prevents a terminal branch.

execution_phases.title: Repository verification, falsification, and security regression
model_steps: Run focused tests for every behavior exercised or changed.

Run typecheck, lint, format check, context/spec/copy/redaction/falsification checks, Firestore tests when configured, core E2E, build, and the repository's full verification gate in the supported environment.
Classify pre-existing red tests separately and prove whether the current change affects them.
Inspect dependency and security output without copying secrets or customer data.
verifiable_outcomes: Every required local gate passes or has an exact reproducible failure.
Behavior changes have regression tests and falsification evidence.
Audit harness failures are never misclassified as application failures.
No secret, customer value, or unsafe fixture entered source or evidence.
human_residual_triggers: An emulator, credential, paid provider, or owner-controlled environment is unavailable.
A protected path change needs owner review.
A test requires a physical device or human perception not represented by deterministic evidence.

execution_phases.title: Diagnosis, repair, clean retry, human queue, and HTML handoff
model_steps: Normalize every failure under the verbose failure contract and deduplicate findings without losing source cases.
For authorized app defects, preserve the failure, implement the smallest correct fix with tests, and clean-retry; otherwise record exact remediation or owner dependency.
Generate only genuinely human-required checks, merge duplicates, and prefill them with model evidence and the next safe action.
Reconcile the run bridge with runner manifest, summary, findings, remediation ledger, capability matrix, auth checkpoint, cleanup, and residue.
Embed the sanitized bridge snapshot into the revised HTML, validate the HTML locally, and leave human statuses untouched.
Finalize and validate the runner only when every case is terminal; otherwise leave a resumable checkpoint and an incomplete overall result.
verifiable_outcomes: Every case is terminal or the run is explicitly resumable and incomplete.
Every failure has root-cause state, evidence, fix/investigation, regression mapping, and next test.
The human queue contains no work the model could still perform safely.
Every model-created artifact is cleaned or listed as residue.
The HTML opens from file://, makes no network requests, restores local human input, and generates a complete copy-back report.
human_residual_triggers: Any unresolved item matches a human-only reason class.
Owner review is required for protected or authority-bearing changes.
A live effect, destructive operation, customer-content judgment, or external dependency remains.

run_bridge_projection.purpose: Give the human HTML one sanitized, compact, stable document while retaining the detailed runner directory as the authoritative evidence store.
required_sections_after_execution: one compact result per audited case or capability
consistency_rules: Counts must reconcile to the actual runner manifest, not the generation snapshot.
Every failed bridge result maps to a runner finding and evidence reference.
Every human queue source_case_id exists in the current manifest or is labeled html_only with a stable reason.
No secret or customer content may be copied from runner evidence into the bridge.
The HTML embedded snapshot hash must equal the final bridge hash recorded by the model.

required_capabilities: Load the embedded sanitized model run on first open.
Import or paste a newer bridge JSON locally without network access.
Persist only non-secret human statuses, evidence, friction, and notes in namespaced localStorage.
Show model-pass evidence separately from the human's final decision.
Compute conservative model, human, process, and overall results.
Render verbose failures and a prioritized residual human queue.
Generate full and failures-only Markdown copy-back responses.
Mask captured notes by default, support light/dark, reset with confirmation, and print safely.
html_end_state.model_edit_boundary: At the end of a run, replace only the EMBEDDED_MODEL_RUN value in the revised HTML with the sanitized completed bridge object and update generated metadata. Do not pre-answer human_status, human_evidence, or human_issue.

completion_definition: The model attempted every reachable case in dependency order.
Every case has a terminal result or the run remains explicitly incomplete with a precise resumption point.
Every material deviation has a verbose failure record and evidence.
Every safe in-scope correction attempted by the model preserves original failure evidence and has a clean retry.
Only genuinely human-required work remains in the deduplicated queue.
The bridge JSON reconciles with runner artifacts.
The revised HTML embeds the sanitized current bridge and passes local desktop, 390x844, persistence, clipboard-fallback, and print checks.
